verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair openness question for a commerce service, so the axis applies. The evidence describes only PayPal-hosted services: form-gated agentic commerce services, a remote MCP server at mcp.paypal.com, and PayPal-issued JWTs on the cart API. The open-source Agent Toolkit on GitHub/npm is a client SDK (a developer building block), and the merchant-hosted cart endpoints are integration callbacks, so neither amounts to self-hosting the core product.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
